jobs.description:
Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) - In the network of science and industry, SAL offers research in the areas of Sensor Systems, RF Systems, Power Electronics, System Integration Technologies and Embedded Systems.
SAL - a great place to research. 1 Senior Scientist - Ion-trap chips (all genders) 

Senior Scientist - Ion-trap chips (all genders)

We are looking for an experienced scientist leading the development of ion-traps and their applications at SAL. You will become part of a highly motivated, international team committed to building up a European pilot line for ion-trap chips (ITCs) realizing the building blocks of next generation quantum technology. Your work will be embedded in an international collaborative network. 

Your future tasks include:

 * Establishment of infrastructure and set-ups for testing and operation of ion trap devices and development of ion trap systems for Quantum technology applications.

 * Coordination and alignment of internal efforts and activities with industrial and academic partners in the pilot line.

 * Contribution to design, simulation and characterization of new ion trap chips.

 * Dissemination, communication and reporting of research findings to both scientific and non-scientific audiences.

 * Supervision of students.

 * Activities in relevant networks. 

 * Project management.

 * Project and funding acquisition.

Your profile:

 * PhD in physics, quantum technology, electronics engineering or similar

 * 3+ years of experience in trapped-ion quantum technology

 * Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing is an advantage

 * Experience in industrial environment is an advantage.

 * Proficiency in English. German or willingness to learn is an asset. 

 * Motivated team player with good communication skills.

 * Personnel management experience is an advantage

 * Willingness to relocate to Austria/Villach.

 * Willingness to travel.

*For this position, candidates with a PhD will join us as Scientist. We also welcome applications from candidates holding a Master's degree and relevant work experience (Junior Level) who are motivated to pursue research in this field. 

Important Facts about SAL:

 * Diverse research activities with many technical challenges.

 * State-of-the-art laboratory facilities and equipment.

 * Location in the heart of Europe in Austria - relocation support for non-European nationalities.

 * Internal and external training opportunities for career development.

 * Family & children friendly - actively shaping the compatibility of family and career.

 * "Vital4SAL" to promote a healthy workplace (e.g. SAL coaching pool, trainings on mental health, physical activities, healthy snacks, 24/7 accident insurance)

 * € 4 per day meal allowance in restaurants or € 2 per working day in supermarkets.

 * Public transport initiative (subsidy for the "Klimaticket")

 * Our values: Open door policy, flexibility in working hours, casual dress code, diverse teams, working with people of different nationalities, informal communication, lifelong learning, compatibility of family and career, sustainability, personal growth, and collective advancement.

This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for employees in non-university research (Research CA) starting in occupational group F (F1 salary = EUR 4.757,- paid 14 times a year, based on 38,5 hours per week). For this position we offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your experience and qualifications, starting with a minimum gross salary of EUR 70.000 (annual, based on an All-in contract and bonus).

Master's / PhD in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

Practical experience with power electronic hardware design, from concept to laboratory validation

Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

The ability to lead and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative workspace

Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.info

Job Title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) – Satellite Analytics Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts research into sustainable land use, environmental resilience, and automated parcel due diligence. Our geospatial research unit develops automated analytical tools that leverage satellite imagery, open geodata, and topography models to assess real estate sites and environmental factors. Role Overview In this role, you will design and implement data pipelines to process multi-spectral satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEM), and municipal cadastral layers to evaluate site topography, ground sealing, and solar potential. Key Responsibilities - Build automated ETL pipelines to ingest and process satellite data (Copernicus/Sentinel, Landsat) and aerial imagery. - Process Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to calculate slope, terrain contouring, and building heights. - Match spatial parcel boundaries (ALKIS/OpenStreetMap) with satellite feature extractions using spatial databases. - Develop algorithmic scripts for rooftop solar potential calculation and environmental risk mapping (e.g., heat islands, flood zones). - Maintain spatial databases and expose analysis results via structured REST APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Surveying, GIS, Computer Science, or equivalent. - Strong programming skills in Python utilizing geospatial libraries: GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL/OGR, or PyProj. - Solid experience with QGIS and spatial relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). - Familiarity with satellite data platforms (Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Open Access Hub, or Sentinel Hub) is an advantage. - Good command of spoken and written English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary structure reflecting technical specialization. - Professional Equipment & Infrastructure: Modern workstation in DHA, Karachi, equipped with high-bandwidth connections and uninterrupted power supply. - Career Growth: Long-term advancement to Senior GIS Architect / Data Lead in Karachi, with access to collaborative international research projects, European geodata publications, and conference opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Candidates demonstrating outstanding analytical achievements over 3–6 months are eligible for our German research mobility track (§ 18d AufenthG), including dedicated relocation guidance and housing / accommodation support in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-geo@iris-institut.info

Job Title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) – Real Estate Optimization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts scientific and applied research into algorithmic decision-making, automated site feasibility, and sustainable structural optimization. We combine spatial constraints, regulatory boundaries, and construction metrics to computationally model future-proof development scenarios. Role Overview As a Computational Algorithm Engineer, you will develop mathematical models and algorithmic scripts that simulate alternative building layouts, floor area ratios (BGF/BRI), and economic optimization scenarios for land parcels. Key Responsibilities - Develop computational logic to simulate building massing, setback constraints, and maximum buildable volumes based on parcel geometries. - Build mathematical evaluation models for multivariate scenario comparisons (e.g., Best-Case vs. Middle-Case commercial vs. mixed-use developments). - Interlink spatial building volumes with structured construction cost indices (German DIN 276 cost groups) to generate dynamic cost models. - Create parameter scripts and automated reporting outputs for feasibility analysis. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers, data engineers, and research directors. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree in Computational Design, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Engineering, or Architecture with an intensive programming focus. - Strong proficiency in Python, C#, or TypeScript; familiarity with computational geometry libraries or parametric modeling (Grasshopper/Rhino.Compute) is highly advantageous. - Solid mathematical foundations in optimization algorithms, geometry processing, and multivariate numerical analysis. - Ability to translate architectural planning regulations into structured code constraints. - Fluent written and verbal communication in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Compensation: Top-tier local remuneration reflecting algorithmic and computational expertise. - Modern Work Hub: Reliable, modern, air-conditioned workspace in DHA Karachi with high-speed fiber infrastructure and power backup. - Sustainable Career Track: Clear promotion tracks into Algorithm Lead or Scientific Computing Lead in Karachi, with ongoing exposure to European construction standards, research publications, and advanced modeling systems. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Outstanding candidates demonstrating mathematical rigor and successful delivery over 3–6 months can qualify for direct transfer to Germany as a Research Associate under § 18d AufenthG, including dedicated administrative assistance, visa handling, and housing / accommodation support on-site. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-ai@iris-institut.info

jobs.occupation: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Bau (Bauinformatik))
jobs.description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

Job Title: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Real Estate Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-REND-02 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-REND-02 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is a German research institution operating at the intersection of architectural digitization, environmental resilience, and sustainable development. We combine engineering precision with visual storytelling to present sustainable development concepts, municipal renewal proposals, and investment pitches to decision-makers. Role Overview We are looking for a creative and technically skilled 3D Architectural Visualizer to translate 3D building models and mass studies into photorealistic imagery, architectural perspectives, and presentation-ready visual assets. Key Responsibilities - Produce photorealistic architectural exterior and interior renderings from BIM/CAD geometry (Revit, SketchUp, Rhino). - Set up realistic lighting, material texturing, vegetation, and context environments for urban and commercial real estate assets. - Create mass studies, conceptual 3D volumes, and interactive walkthroughs for project feasibility presentations. - Perform post-production image enhancements and color grading in Adobe Photoshop. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers and research leads to accurately reflect structural design intent. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Visualization, 3D Design, Animation, or related field (e.g., Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture, DUET, or comparable). - Proficiency in industry-standard visualization software: 3ds Max, Blender, Unreal Engine, Lumion, or Corona / V-Ray. - Strong aesthetic sense for architectural composition, atmospheric lighting, and material detailing. - A portfolio showing realistic architectural renderings is required for consideration. - Professional working proficiency in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package matching market rates. - Infrastructure: High-performance rendering hardware and reliable, air-conditioned studio space in DHA. - In-Country Career Growth: Rapid progression to Senior Visualizer or Art Director within our growing studio, with continuous training in real-time engines and computational visualization tools. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Exceptional performers proving dedication and high visual standard over 3–6 months can qualify for an international transfer to our research facilities in Germany (§ 18d AufenthG), fully supported with visa facilitation, relocation, and housing / accommodation support.
